What Causes Hiccups? — HIC! What muscle beneath your lungs just bounced without asking your permission?
Kids science answer for "what causes hiccups for kids" with fun 2D animation by BabyBeats Rhymo!

A hiccup is a sudden spasm of the diaphragm muscle under your lungs that pulls air in fast and snaps your vocal cords shut.

BabyBeats Rhymo creates kid-safe 2D science cartoons and funny educational stories every day for curious US kids and families!
